body:
Owner disposition received in this chat on 2026-10-27: “Approve this one-time exception,” responding to the question limited to accepting preserved source history, passing tests and separate review for the stale O/E hint verification-helper correction.

Record this as a one-time exception for that correction only. Its missing pre-correction RED remains a historical gap; no retrospective test-first claim or full strict chronology is made. The original product/interface RED and later separately qualified REDs keep their actual scopes. This approval changes no other test, source-preservation, privacy, cleanup, separate-review, CI or merge requirement and grants no future bypass.

I am recording the bounded disposition in PROJECT.md. Acceptance may proceed using the explicit alternative evidence for this one correction; merge still waits for all remaining gates.
